```{r libs}
NPS_API_KEY <- "Pk9LPjGtrr8QCJrmfhdrjmCHWWwTLn8gF9CNDPQ9"

```

## Pull images

```{r pull}
nps <- request("https://developer.nps.gov/api/v1/parks") |>
  req_url_query(
    parkCode = "acad",
    fields   = "images",
    api_key  = NPS_API_KEY
  ) |>
  req_perform() |> # this sends the actual request
  resp_body_json()  # this takes the output from the request and sends it to us as a json that r can read

nps_images <- tibble(park = nps$data) |>
  hoist(park, park_code = "parkCode", images = "images") |> # pulls out the cols of a list and puts them into the larger dataset
  unnest_longer(images) |> #unnests the lists, turns each element into a row
  unnest_wider(images) |> # does the same thing, but for cols
  select(park_code, title, caption, credit, url)

write_csv(nps_images, "nps_images.csv")

```
